title: Local adic heart defects and cover detection without a global coefficient field
statement: Fix the finite-field and coefficient datum of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $T$ be a locally finite-type $k_0$-scheme [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and let $\mathcal H_{\mathrm{loc}}(T)$ be the category of cartesian local constructible adic heart data of [def-dl-a1-locally-constructible-adic-heart]. Thus an object assigns to every separated finite-type open $V\subset T$ an object $K_V\in\Sh_c(V,\Qlb)$ [def-weil-constructible-heart, def-weil-pbc-qbar-category], with the specified completed restriction isomorphisms and their cocycle; arrows are compatible families. For a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme $V$, the notation $\Sh_c(V,\Qlb)$ here denotes the heart of the bounded common-stage standard t-structure over the field $k_0$, as specified for an arbitrary field with $\ell$ invertible in [lem-per-adic-heart-pullback-fibres]: its objects are those isomorphic to finite-stage objects lying in both localized standard halves. This makes explicit the base-field extension of the notation in [def-weil-constructible-heart], whose displayed definition is over $k$. This category is abelian [def-sp-abelian]. For each separated finite-type open $V$, evaluation $K\mapsto K_V$ is exact; kernels and cokernels in $\mathcal H_{\mathrm{loc}}(T)$ are computed componentwise, with the induced restriction isomorphisms. For a short complex $A\xrightarrow{f}B\xrightarrow{g}C$ with $gf=0$ [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence], its left kernel $\ker f$, middle homology $\ker g/\operatorname{im}f$ and right cokernel $\operatorname{coker}g$ are cartesian local heart objects whose evaluations are the three corresponding defects in $\Sh_c(V,\Qlb)$. If $\{U_i\}_{i\in I}$ is any covering of $T$ by separated finite-type opens, then a local heart object $K$ is zero if and only if $K_{U_i}=0$ for every $i$. In particular each of the three defects is zero if and only if all its evaluations on this covering are zero. No quasi-compactness of $T$, finiteness of the covering or common coefficient field for all of $T$ is assumed.

proof.text: For every short complex S and evaluation F, use F.mapIso of S.leftHomologyIsoCokernelLift.symm, then S.mapLeftHomologyIso F in the reverse direction, then (S.map F).leftHomologyIsoCokernelLift. This gives the stated middle-defect isomorphism for the literal cokernel of the kernel lift. ShortComplex.Exact.map proves evaluation exactness.

proof.text: An evaluation preserves zero arrows, so it sends every zero object to a zero object. Conversely apply [lem-dl-a1-local-heart-cover-basis-zero] to a family vanishing on the cover. Each evaluated identity equals zero. The morphism extensionality of compatible families makes the global identity zero, so the global object is zero by IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero.

proof.text: Apply this zero-object equivalence to kernel(f), cokernel(kernel.lift g f), and cokernel(g). For each cover member transfer IsZero through respectively PreservesKernel.iso, the middle-defect isomorphism already proved, and PreservesCokernel.iso. forall_congr and transitivity of iff give the three required defect equivalences.
